pages.text: Hunt these in Overworld structures — iron or copper gear is enough if you dodge actively.$(br2)Several drop a unique weapon ($(l:icraft:bosses/unique_weapons)Unique Weapons$(/l)), and every kill counts toward your $(t2){{tier 1 rushpct}}$() boss-rush clear and banks Combat tokens.$(br2)The boss compass and bonfire waystones point you at arena structures as you discover them.

pages.title: Mutant Monsters
pages.text: $(bold)Mutant Zombie$() — Overworld surface + structures. Drops: $(item)Hulk Hammer$() (25% — 20 attack damage, 0.5 attack speed, Knockback II, +50% vs undead), Uncommon Ink (20%), Blood Rune (10%).$(br2)$(bold)Mutant Skeleton$() — Overworld surface. Drops: Uncommon Ink (20%), Ice Rune (10%).$(br2)$(bold)Mutant Creeper$() — Overworld surface. Drops: Uncommon Ink (20%), Fire Rune (10%).

pages.title: Structure Bosses
pages.text: $(bold)Terramity$() — $(item)Gob, King of Gnomes$() (Court of Gnomes — summon him with an emerald), $(item)Super Sniffer$() (Ancient Outcrop). Enchanter Merlin is a Tier 3 boss (the Nether's Chthonic Cathedral).$(br2)$(bold)Mowzie's Mobs$() — Ferrous Wroughtnaut (underground chamber), Umvuthi (savanna), the Sculptor (mountain peaks), Naga (coastal cliffs). Frostmaw moved to Everbright (Tier 2).

pages.title: Mini-Bosses
pages.text: $(bold)Iron's Spellbooks$() casters walk the Overworld too, but the Archevoker and its kin are {{boss irons_spellbooks:archevoker tier}} bosses: their tokens and their boss rush are Tier 3's.$(br2)$(bold)Brutal Bosses$() — champion-level mobs guarding Overworld dungeons, with loot of their own. They are on no kill roster: no Codex tokens.$(br2)$(note)Mutant Monsters crafting recipes are stripped — the Hulk Hammer + rune/ink drops are the intended T1 reward path.$()$(br2)$(bold)Next: run /icraft codex bosses to see your clear count.$()
